name: Amalaki Panaka (Indian Gooseberry Drink)
description: A traditional health drink with natural ingredients, used as an immediate energy supplement.
instructions: Steam cook the gooseberries, de-seed them, and grind into a paste.
Extract juice from the paste. Add about 300 ml more water and squeeze the pulp again to get more juice.
Prepare palm sugar syrup by boiling 1 kg palm sugar in 200 ml water.
Mix the prepared gooseberry juice with the palm sugar syrup. Stir well until combined.
health_benefits: Rich source of calcium, potassium, vitamin C, B complex, and antioxidants
Good for osteoarthritis, atherosclerosis, anemia, peptic ulcer
contraindications: Not advisable for individuals with Diabetes mellitus due to high sugar content.

name: Golden Milk (Haldi Doodh)
description: Traditional turmeric milk drink that supports immunity and reduces inflammation.
instructions: Heat 1 cup of milk (dairy or plant-based)
Add 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
Add a pinch of black pepper and ginger powder
Sweeten with honey or jaggery to taste
Simmer for 5 minutes and serve warm
contraindications: Avoid if you have gallstones or are taking blood-thinning medications

name: Coconut Rice (Narikela Anna)
description: Cooling and nourishing rice dish perfect for Pitta constitution.
instructions: Cook 1 cup basmati rice with extra water
In a pan, heat 2 tbsp coconut oil
Add mustard seeds, curry leaves, and ginger
Add cooked rice and 1/2 cup fresh coconut
Season with salt and mix gently
contraindications: May increase Kapha if consumed in excess

name: Cumin Tea (Jira Jal)
description: Digestive tea that enhances appetite and supports metabolism.
instructions: Boil 2 cups of water
Add 1 teaspoon cumin seeds
Simmer for 10 minutes
Strain and serve warm
Can add a pinch of rock salt if desired
contraindications: Avoid in excess if you have hyperacidity

name: Ginger Honey Tea (Adrak Madhu Chai)
description: Warming tea excellent for cold weather and digestive support.
instructions: Boil 2 cups water with 1 inch fresh ginger
Simmer for 15 minutes
Strain into cups
Add 1 teaspoon honey when slightly cooled
Serve warm
contraindications: Avoid in excess if you have high Pitta or hyperacidity
